question: Can ordinary causal-LM mixed SFT learn one direct molecular language for de-novo generation and source editing without a mode router?

round_1.training: balanced mixed SFT with matched de-novo-only and edit-only LoRA controls
round_1.split: development condition hashes and nonempty source hashes are removed from training
round_1.negative_transfer: mixed minus matched-single token NLL <= 0.50 and greedy validity loss <= 0.10 per mode

round_2: No DPO or ORPO unless the SFT gate passes; any later preferences must be train-derived.
